- Fixture export unchanged byte-for-byte: 96 lines, no `\r`, 25 stderr `skipped` lines, summary `CHF 20 10754.55 / EUR 75 43418.43 / skipped 25`.

One judgment call worth flagging: a customer name containing `;` still gets quoted by `csv.writer` (`"A;B"`). The spec says "fields are separated by semicolons" but says nothing about quoting, so I left the stdlib default rather than hand-rolling a non-conforming writer. Say the word if you want quoting suppressed there.
